files.name: netlist.txt
files.text:
COMPONENTS:
 - R1: 1kΩ res0402 resistor
 - R2: 10kΩ res0402 resistor
 - LED1: LED1, source_component
 - U1: soic8

NET: VCC
  - U1 pin8
  - R1 pin1

NET: GND
  - U1 pin4
  - R2 pin2

NET: LED1_pos
  - R1 pin2
  - LED1 pin1 (+)

NET: LED1_neg
  - LED1 pin2 (-)
  - U1 pin1


COMPONENT_PINS:
R1 (1kΩ res0402)
- pin1(anode, pos, left): NETS(VCC)
- pin2(cathode, neg, right): NETS(LED1_pos)

R2 (10kΩ res0402)
- pin1(anode, pos, left): NOT_CONNECTED
- pin2(cathode, neg, right): NETS(GND)

LED1
- pin1(anode, pos, left): NETS(LED1_pos)
- pin2(cathode, neg, right): NETS(LED1_neg)

U1
- pin1: NETS(LED1_neg)
- pin2: NOT_CONNECTED
- pin3: NOT_CONNECTED
- pin4: NETS(GND)
- pin5: NOT_CONNECTED
- pin6: NOT_CONNECTED
- pin7: NOT_CONNECTED
- pin8: NETS(VCC)
